sv.title: Tragedin: Giovanni dog när han hoppade fallskärm
sv.summary: Han var känd i sociala medier för sina våghalsiga fallskärmshopp. Men när 21-åriga Giovanni gav sig upp i luften i helgen var tragedin framme. – Moder Jord kan vara brutal, säger vännen Curtis Haley, till Daily Mail.

en.title: Tragedy: Giovanni died when he jumped with a parachute
en.summary: He was known on social media for his daredevil parachute jumps. But when 21-year-old Giovanni took off into the air over the weekend, tragedy struck. – Mother Earth can be brutal, says friend Curtis Haley, to Daily Mail.
